findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: start_signup · Private data: start_signup, check_signup_status · Public sink: start_signup.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: start_signup · Private data: start_signup, check_signup_status · Public sink: start_signup

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
